description: List the telco providers currently listed on Wireless Choices, with the network each one sells access to and how many plans of each type are listed. Use this to resolve a provider name to its slug before calling search_plans or get_plan.
name: list_providers

error.description: Error code, present only on an error result

message.description: User-facing error message, present only on an error result

network.description: "Telstra network", "Telstra Wholesale network", "Optus network", "Vodafone network", a host network with a qualifier in brackets, "nbn", or null

title: List providers on Wireless Choices
